title: Click a post number to cross-reference it
notes: Click any post's #number to copy a link to it, then paste that link into a post anywhere to cross-reference the original — the target gains a "Mentioned in" backlink and its author is notified. Forums can also show a Stripe-backed Donate card in the sidebar.

changelog.text: Click a post's #number to copy its link; paste it anywhere to cross-reference that post (with a "Mentioned in" backlink + author notification).
Optional sidebar Donate card backed by a Stripe buy button, configured in admin settings.
